annotations.text:
Round four — the Galaxy hero, chosen and refined.
The chip now states what was parsed (12 .org files · 67 KB → HTML); nothing blinks. The marquee carries the project's own numbers: last build, articles per language, KB / lines / headings of Org, words and reading time, the engine version, the gates.
The three drawings tell one story with no words: 1 the .org file feeds the engine (gears turn) and components come out · 2 the components are dragged into their slots on the page · 3 the assembled page ships to the host packet by packet until the check.
Under them: made with org2html, linking GitHub. Phone order: animation, title, marquee, drawings. Everything below is the validated archive.
